valuesBaseline.problem: Every Friday a department head needs one weekly maintenance report compiled from entries submitted by team leads. Compiling by hand takes half a day and entries get lost.
valuesBaseline.targetUsers: Team leads (view and edit own entries only); department head (view all, sole exporter)
valuesBaseline.coreFeatures:
1. Team leads submit a weekly entry per equipment line
2. System compiles all entries into one weekly report
3. Department head exports the compiled report
4. Late, missing and duplicate entries are marked in the report
valuesBaseline.successCriteria: Department head receives one compiled report by Monday 09:00 containing every submitted entry, with missing, late and duplicate entries visibly marked.
valuesBaseline.mustPreserve: Submitted entries are immutable once submitted; the existing equipment line codes stay unchanged.
valuesBaseline.platforms: Web browser on office Windows PCs
valuesBaseline.dataNeeds: Synthetic equipment line code, weekly status text, submitting team lead name, submission time. Source: weekly CSV drop only. No personal evaluation data.
valuesBaseline.outOfScope: No automatic scoring or ranking of team leads or people. No email sending in this version.
valuesBaseline.constraints: Team leads may correct their entry until the Friday 17:00 deadline. Deadline timezone not decided.

actions.answer: Team lead submits one entry per equipment line before the deadline; the system compiles all entries; the department head reviews and exports the report.
Team leads view and edit only their own entries. The department head views all entries and is the only person who can export. Nobody else may export.
CONFLICT C1: mustPreserve says submitted entries are immutable once submitted, but constraints says team leads may correct their entry until Friday 17:00.
Source: weekly CSV drop only. Compiled reports are kept 12 months. UNKNOWN U1: how long raw entries are kept is not decided.

Missing entry: show a NO ENTRY row, never guess content. Duplicate: keep the latest and keep the earlier in history. Late: flag LATE and include in the next report. UNKNOWN U2: deadline timezone is not decided. UNKNOWN U3: behavior when the deadline falls on a public holiday is not decided.
Department head receives one compiled report by Monday 09:00 with every submitted entry and visible missing, late and duplicate marks. UNKNOWN U4: export file format is not decided.
Resolution of C1: corrections before Friday 17:00 create a new entry version; after the deadline entries are immutable. No automatic scoring or ranking of people.
Team leads view and edit only their own entries and may export their own team's section. The department head views and exports all. Auditors have read-only view and no export.
Source: weekly CSV drop only. Compiled reports are kept 12 months. UNKNOWN U1: how long raw entries are kept is not decided.
